guarantees.claim: funcpad is assigned 5'b00110 when mode_i is Sha3, 5'b11111 when Shake, 5'b00100 when CShake, and 5'b00001 for any other mode_i value.

uncertain_points.claim: The default case assigns funcpad = 5'b00001 with comment 'Just create non-padding but pad10*1 only' for any mode_i not matching Sha3, Shake, or CShake. It is unclear if this fallback behavior is safe or intended when mode_i is corrupted or illegally set.
uncertain_points.cond: mode_i is not Sha3, Shake, or CShake
uncertain_points.risk: If an attacker can force mode_i to an illegal value, the resulting padding may deviate from standard SHA-3/SHAKE and compromise digest integrity or enable collision attacks.
